subject: alert
title: Angular Alert inputs named role and title leak onto the host: nested role=alert and a native tooltip
description: hw-alert declares inputs called role and title. With static attributes (the form used by the guide and README) Angular also leaves them on the <hw-alert> host. role="alert" therefore yields an alert nested in an alert, role="group" with aria-label yields a named outer group and an unnamed inner group, and title="..." gives the whole alert a native browser tooltip repeating the heading. subject: accessibility
title: Packaged skip links and content-navigation links go to the site root under <base href="/hawiyah/">

verifierNote: Confirmed in Chromium (Playwright, routed pages): a page at /hawiyah/components/button with <base href="/hawiyah/"> and the packaged skip-link markup href="#main-content". Tab focused the link with href http://verify.local/hawiyah/#main-content, and Enter loaded the HOME page. Without <base>, the link stayed on the page. The scope is broader than stated: with <base href="/"> (the Angular CLI default) on /components/button, Enter also went to /#main-content (HOME). So every routed Angular app at a non-root route is affected, not only the /hawiyah/ deployment. hw-content-navigation (content-navigation.ts:53-56) preventDefaults plain and keyboard clicks, so only modified clicks, open-in-new-tab and copied links are wrong there.
